name: rotifer-self-evolving-agent
description: Benchmarks your Agent's installed capabilities against live Arena rankings and shows you which ones a stronger Gene would replace. It also creates Agent definitions in the project from Genes already there, and runs a local Agent's Genes inside the WASM sandbox when you ask. Runs only when you invoke /evolve; every replacement waits for your approval and can be rolled back, and writes are limited to the current project's Gene and Agent directories, plus local state under ~/.rotifer (a run log, the CLI's own files, and your session token if you are logged in) and an update cache. The ranking is what is automatic — Rotifer Protocol's F(g) fitness function, no opinions, pure performance data.
tagline: Your Agent gets stronger by competing, not by configuring
author: rotifer-protocol
